title: localsystem/remotesystem reference bin/podman, bin/podman-remote, bin/quadlet with no build prerequisite in makefile
body:
**Environment:**
```
Windows 11 host, WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS
go version go1.25.9 linux/amd64
commit 10b0bc1d (main)
```

i was reading #29357 (the ginkgo/localunit prerequisite fix), then checked every other Makefile target for the same pattern.

**Repro:**
```
$ ls bin/
ls: cannot access 'bin/': No such file or directory

$ make -n localsystem
```
```
# Wipe existing config, database, and cache: start with clean slate.
rm -f -rf /home/rocki/.local/share/containers /home/rocki/.config/containers
PODMAN=.../bin/podman QUADLET=.../bin/quadlet bats -T --filter-tags '!ci:parallel' test/system/
PODMAN=.../bin/podman QUADLET=.../bin/quadlet bats -T --filter-tags ci:parallel -j $(nproc) test/system/
```
there is zero build step anywhere in that plan. `localunit` now has `.install.ginkgo` as a prerequisite after #29357. `localsystem` has nothing before it that would build `bin/podman` or `bin/quadlet`.

Same thing with `remotesystem` (references `bin/podman-remote` instead):
```
$ make -n remotesystem
```
```
rm -f -rf /home/rocki/.local/share/containers /home/rocki/.config/containers
PODMAN=.../bin/podman-remote QUADLET=.../bin/quadlet \
	bats -T --filter-tags '!ci:parallel' test/system/
PODMAN=.../bin/podman-remote QUADLET=.../bin/quadlet \
	bats -T --filter-tags ci:parallel -j $(nproc) test/system/
```

**Verification:**

I did not run `make localsystem` to completion and watch it fail on the missing binary itself. I tried twice but hit something unrelated before reaching that point:

- First attempt failed on CRLF line endings in `test/system/*.bash`. That's my own checkout, not a repo bug. Fixed it and reran.
- Second attempt got past that, but `setup_suite`'s `gen-tls` helper calls `openssl req ... -quiet`, and the OpenSSL build on my WSL Ubuntu 24.04 install doesn't support that flag (`req: Unknown option or message digest: quiet`). Pre-existing gap in my own test environment, also unrelated to this fix.

I also couldn't get a full real compile of `bin/podman`. It fails on `cmd/podman`'s cgo dependencies: `gpgme` and `libseccomp` dev headers aren't installed, and installing them needs `sudo`, which I didn't have a password for.

What I am confident in is that `make -n localsystem` and `make -n remotesystem`, run on a genuinely empty `bin/` directory, show no build step at all before referencing those binaries. i confirmed identically on two separate checkouts of the same commit. That is the actual bug: a missing Makefile prerequisite.
